flags.message: Decisive pre-snapshot public signal, disclosed for hygiene: the petition and the BIO both record that the identical question was denied on Jan 12, 2026 in Schneider v. United States (No. 25-685, 13 consolidated CAAF cases) and Johnson (No. 25-682), and in Dominguez-Garcia (No. 25-730); a further companion, Zhong (No. 25-742), was pending at BIO time. This drove the forecast well below the band anchor. No outcome for this docket was seen; CourtListener shows it last modified 2026-06-17 with no termination.
